description:
Handbuilt unicorn series SB2 klunk.

Longer top tube L/XL. All the same geo at the L/XL with a 26.5” top tube.

MRB sweepy cruiser bars with brazed 40mm La Roca shorty stem makes it ride like a large. Talk to me if you need that true XXL fit.

Handbuilt bread truck brazed bi-plane fork with hammered blade caps and stack-o-dimes brazing.

The wheels aren't built in house but they are pretty cool. Profile front hub, rebuilt souped up KT coaster hub with the cooler. Baby blue powder coated spokes to match that cool selle royal saddle. OG rhyno lite rims. Yum

One of the most unique SB2's to date. Hop on it to hop on it…
